Hello /v/NoMansSkyTheGame!

While some of you may want to name your planets 'Pandora' or 'Dune,' I wanted to have a fast and efficient system to name things that I come across. This system had to be somewhat familiar textually, yet foreign enough that you haven't heard of the results.

Thus, No Man's Sky Naming Generator was born! Initially I was just creating this for myself, however once I did the math I found out that it created 7,413,380,406 individual and unique names I had to share! Your options are as follows...

  • The Original- This generator has no chance of spawning numbers and has a total of 73,399,806 unique names.
  • With Numbers Always On- This generator will always spawn the previous names with a random roman numeral 1-100. There are 7,339,980,600 unique names.
  • Original and Numbers- This generator will have a chance to spawn with and without numbers. There are 7,413,380,406 unique names, the most out of these generators.

You can make your own, links down bellow, but if you don't really want to and you have an idea for another generator but using some sort of other input(Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Cosmic, etc. terms) let me know! I'll try my best and fully credit you. If you have a Wikipedia list, or something similar, that would make the process a lot easier as well!

Please enjoy! Below I will explain how the generators work, so if you're interested, keep reading! If you aren't, have a great day!

These generators work on four relatively large lists.

  • 106 Prefixes
  • 1367 Roots
  • 423 Suffixes
  • 101 Numerals

Most of the prefixes/roots/suffixes are English based and include Greek, Latin, as well as a few other similar languages. To gather them, I went to a few websites such as wikipedia, learnthat, and englishclub. If you notice any mistakes or conjunctions that aren't normal, please let me know. The words are listed alphabetically(for the most part)in the source, which is farther down the page if you're interested. A lot of the work is done by the website, http://orteil.dashnet.org/randomgen/. In fact, here's the FAQ if you're interested in making one for yourself. I am not the site creator, but I thought it'd be cool to show you guys something I made and wanted to provide proper sauce.

Speaking of sauce, here is what I typed up over the last day. Each is very similar but functions different enough in an attempt to appeal to a wider audience. In my mixed code/list you can also see the percentages for the numerals in how they appear. I ranked 1-20 as familiar so they received a 3%. Anything with 1-3 characters also receives this 3%. 4 character-ed numerals received 2% due to an increased "difficulty"/they-don't-look-as-nice-but-hey-still-not-that-bad. Then anything with 5 or more received 1% because they're kind of hideous in my opinion, although I didn't want to get rid of them. Anyways, original text files bellow.

  • Original
  • Numbers
  • Mixed

Sorry for a ludicrously long post about something really simple, but I had a lot of fun making this and I can't wait for this game to come out!
